    "FUNCTION view_bcset_import.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Local Interface:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(OBJECT) LIKE  OBJH-OBJECTNAME",
    "*\"     VALUE(ORDER) TYPE  TRKORR",
    "*\"     VALUE(VARIANT_FOR_SELECTION) LIKE  TVIMV-VARIANT OPTIONAL",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(ACTOPTS) TYPE  SCPRACTOPT",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(RETURNCODE) LIKE  SY-SUBRC",
    "*\"  TABLES",
    "*\"      BCSET_VALUES STRUCTURE  SCPR_VALS",
    "*\"      BCSET_TEXT_VALUES STRUCTURE  SCPR_VALL OPTIONAL",
    "*\"      BCSET_DEL_RECORDS STRUCTURE  SCPRRECA OPTIONAL",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "",
    "  CONSTANTS: ext_suffix(10) TYPE c VALUE '_EXTRACT[]',",
    "             tot_suffix(8) TYPE c VALUE '_TOTAL[]',",
    "             no_msg_var LIKE sy-msgv1 VALUE ' ',",
    "             import_mode(1) TYPE c VALUE 'D',",
    "             import_specmode(1) TYPE c VALUE 'P',  \"Profilimport",
    "             rc_warn  LIKE sy-subrc VALUE '4',              \"#EC STR_NUM",
    "                                                            \"#EC NEEDED",
    "             rc_error LIKE sy-subrc VALUE '8',              \"#EC STR_NUM",
    "             rc_fatal LIKE sy-subrc VALUE '12'.             \"#EC STR_NUM",
    "  DATA: header LIKE vimdesc OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,",
    "        namtab LIKE vimnamtab OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,",
    "        rangetab LIKE vimsellist  OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,",
    "        fu_to_excl LIKE vimexclfun OCCURS 0,",
    "        entries_to_import LIKE vimmodix OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,",
    "        profile_error LIKE sy-subrc,",
    "        upd_requ(1) TYPE c, length TYPE i,",
    "        read_fcode(4) TYPE c,",
    "        results LIKE vimmodres,                              \"#EC NEEDED",
    "        h_impres TYPE slctr_tables_keys WITH HEADER LINE,",
    "        table_length TYPE i, x_table_length TYPE i,",
    "        h_ix TYPE i, h_rc TYPE i, sellist_ix TYPE i,",
    "        fill_subset(1) TYPE c,",
    "        cur_value LIKE vimsellist-value,",
    "        tot_name(40) TYPE c, ext_name(40) TYPE c,",
    "        last_msg TYPE vimty_message,                     \"#EC NEEDED",
    "        msg_var LIKE sy-msgv1, msg_var2 LIKE sy-msgv2,",
    "        tabkey  LIKE scpracpr-tablekey,",
    "        fpool_name LIKE trdir-name,",
    "        import_keytab(1024) TYPE x OCCURS 0,",
    "        dummy_extract LIKE extract_ul OCCURS 0,",
    "        tabtype TYPE ob_typ,",
    "        bcset_values_wa TYPE scpr_vals.",
    "",
    "  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <extract> TYPE table, <total> TYPE table,",
    "                 <ext_wa> TYPE ANY, <ext_action> TYPE ANY,",
    "                 <ext_wax> TYPE x, <ext_key> TYPE x,",
    "                 <ext_wa_struc> TYPE ANY,",
    "                 <h_1> TYPE ANY.",
    "",
    "* globale Variable für VIM_PROCESS_MESSAGE",
    "  vim_no_dialog = 'X'. vim_import_profile = 'X'.",
    "  vim_view_name = object. CLEAR vim_profile_errorkey.",
    "  vim_import_no_message = 'X'.",
    "  READ TABLE bcset_values INDEX 1 INTO bcset_values_wa.",
    "  vim_bcset_id = bcset_values_wa-id.",
    "  vim_actopts = actopts.",
    "",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_GET_DDIC_INFO'",
    "    EXPORTING",
    "      viewname              = object",
    "      variant_for_selection = variant_for_selection",
    "    TABLES",
    "      sellist               = rangetab",
    "      x_header              = header",
    "      x_namtab              = namtab",
    "    EXCEPTIONS",
    "      no_tvdir_entry        = 1",
    "      table_not_found       = 2.",
    "  CASE sy-subrc.",
    "    WHEN 0.",
    "    WHEN 1.",
    "      msg_var = object.",
    "      tabtype = 'V'. \"HCG Just to have s.th, but error should not occur",
    "      PERFORM vim_bc_process_message USING 'SV' 'I' 'A' '037' msg_var",
    "                              no_msg_var no_msg_var no_msg_var tabtype.",
    "      returncode = rc_fatal. EXIT.",
    "    WHEN 2.",
    "      msg_var = object.",
    "      tabtype = 'V'. \"HCG Just to have s.th, but error should not occur",
    "      PERFORM vim_bc_process_message USING 'SV' 'I' 'A' '028' msg_var",
    "                            no_msg_var no_msg_var no_msg_var tabtype.",
    "      returncode = rc_fatal. EXIT.",
    "  ENDCASE.",
    "  IF header-bastab EQ space.",
    "    tabtype = 'V'.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    tabtype = 'S'.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "***********************************************************************",
    "* Message in Activation Log if x_header-TEXTTBEXST = SPACE and",
    "* bcset_text_values is not empty. \"HCG",
    "  READ TABLE bcset_text_values INDEX 1.",
    "  IF sy-subrc EQ 0 AND header-texttbexst = space.",
    "    msg_var = header-viewname.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_PROT_DATA_WRITE'",
    "          EXPORTING",
    "            act_id           = vim_actopts-act_id",
    "            bcset_id         = vim_bcset_id",
    "            objectname       = object",
    "*           tablename        = object",
    "*            tabletype        = tabtype",
    "*           tablekey         = tabkey",
    "            msgid            = 'SV'",
    "            msgty            = 'E'",
    "            msgno            = '203'",
    "            var1             = msg_var",
    "*           var2             = msg_var2",
    "*           VAR3             =",
    "*           VAR4             =",
    "            objecttype       = tabtype.",
    "    IF returncode = 0. returncode = rc_error. ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "**************************************************************",
    "  READ TABLE header INDEX 1.",
    "  IF header-existency EQ rdonly.",
    "    PERFORM vim_bc_process_message USING 'SV' 'I' 'A' '044' no_msg_var",
    "                             no_msg_var no_msg_var no_msg_var tabtype.",
    "    returncode = rc_fatal. EXIT.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  fpool_name      = header-fpoolname.",
    "",
    "* authority check",
    "  IF header-newgener EQ space. \"4.5A: support individual auth. checks",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_AUTHORITY_CHECK'",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        view_action                    = 'U'",
    "        view_name                      = object",
    "        no_warning_for_clientindep     = 'X'",
    "      EXCEPTIONS",
    "        table_not_found                = 5",
    "        no_authority                   = 8",
    "        no_clientindependent_authority = 9",
    "        no_linedependent_authority     = 10.",
    "    CASE sy-subrc.",
    "      WHEN 0.",
    "      WHEN 5.",
    "        msg_var = object.",
    "        PERFORM vim_bc_process_message USING 'SV' 'I' 'A' '028' msg_var",
    "                               no_msg_var no_msg_var no_msg_var tabtype.",
    "        returncode = rc_fatal. EXIT.",
    "      WHEN 9.",
    "        PERFORM vim_bc_process_message USING 'TB' 'I' 'A' '109'",
    "                   no_msg_var no_msg_var no_msg_var no_msg_var tabtype.",
    "        returncode = rc_fatal. EXIT.",
    "      WHEN 8.",
    "        PERFORM vim_bc_process_message USING 'SV' 'I' 'A' '053'",
    "                   no_msg_var no_msg_var no_msg_var no_msg_var tabtype.",
    "        returncode = rc_fatal. EXIT.",
    "      WHEN 10.",
    "       PERFORM vim_bc_process_message USING 'SV' 'I' 'A' '755' sy-msgv1",
    "                                   sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4 tabtype.",
    "        returncode = rc_fatal. EXIT.",
    "    ENDCASE.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "* enqueue view",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_ENQUEUE'",
    "    EXPORTING",
    "      view_name        = object",
    "      action           = 'E'",
    "      enqueue_mode     = 'E'",
    "    EXCEPTIONS",
    "      foreign_lock     = 1",
    "      system_failure   = 2",
    "      table_not_found  = 5",
    "      client_reference = 7.",
    "  CASE sy-subrc.",
    "    WHEN 0.",
    "    WHEN 1.",
    "      PERFORM vim_bc_process_message USING 'SV' 'I' 'A' '049' sy-msgv1",
    "                     no_msg_var no_msg_var no_msg_var tabtype.",
    "      returncode = rc_fatal. EXIT.",
    "    WHEN 2.",
    "      msg_var = object.",
    "      PERFORM vim_bc_process_message USING 'SV' 'I' 'A' '050' msg_var",
    "                     no_msg_var no_msg_var no_msg_var tabtype.",
    "      returncode = rc_fatal. EXIT.",
    "    WHEN 5.",
    "      msg_var = object.",
    "      PERFORM vim_bc_process_message USING 'SV' 'I' 'A' '028' msg_var",
    "                     no_msg_var no_msg_var no_msg_var tabtype.",
    "      returncode = rc_fatal. EXIT.",
    "    WHEN 7.",
    "      msg_var = sy-mandt.",
    "      PERFORM vim_bc_process_message USING 'SV' 'I' 'A' '054' msg_var",
    "                     no_msg_var no_msg_var no_msg_var tabtype.",
    "      returncode = rc_fatal. EXIT.",
    "  ENDCASE.",
    "",
    "* determine well-sized internal tables",
    "  table_length = header-after_tabc / cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.",
    "*  tab lg. + action + mark",
    "  IF header-bastab NE space AND header-texttbexst NE space.",
    "    table_length = table_length",
    "     + header-aft_txttbc / cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.",
    "    x_table_length = table_length + 3.",
    "* txtb+txtact",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    x_table_length = table_length + 2.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF x_table_length LE ultra_short_tab.",
    "    tot_name = 'TOTAL_US[]'. ext_name = 'EXTRACT_US[]'.",
    "    ASSIGN: extract_us[] TO <extract>, total_us[] TO <total>,",
    "            extract_us+table_length(1) TO <ext_action>,",
    "            extract_us(x_table_length) TO <ext_wa>.                       \"#EC RC_READ",
    "    h_rc = sy-subrc.",
    "    FREE: extract_vs, total_vs,",
    "          extract_s, total_s,",
    "          extract_m, total_m,",
    "          extract_l, total_l,",
    "          extract_vl, total_vl,",
    "          extract_ul, total_ul.",
    "  ELSEIF x_table_length LE very_short_tab.",
    "    tot_name = 'TOTAL_VS[]'. ext_name = 'EXTRACT_VS[]'.",
    "    ASSIGN: extract_vs[] TO <extract>, total_vs[] TO <total>,",
    "            extract_vs+table_length(1) TO <ext_action>,",
    "            extract_vs(x_table_length) TO <ext_wa>.                      \"#EC RC_READ",
    "    h_rc = sy-subrc.",
    "    FREE: extract_us, total_us,",
    "          extract_s, total_s,",
    "          extract_m, total_m,",
    "          extract_l, total_l,",
    "          extract_vl, total_vl,",
    "          extract_ul, total_ul.",
    "  ELSEIF x_table_length LE short_tab.",
    "    tot_name = 'TOTAL_S[]'. ext_name = 'EXTRACT_S[]'.",
    "    ASSIGN: extract_s[] TO <extract>, total_s[] TO <total>,",
    "            extract_s+table_length(1) TO <ext_action>,",
    "            extract_s(x_table_length) TO <ext_wa>.                       \"#EC RC_READ",
    "    h_rc = sy-subrc.",
    "    FREE: extract_us, total_us,",
    "          extract_vs, total_vs,",
    "          extract_m, total_m,",
    "          extract_l, total_l,",
    "          extract_vl, total_vl,",
    "          extract_ul, total_ul.",
    "  ELSEIF x_table_length LE middle_tab.",
    "    tot_name = 'TOTAL_M[]'. ext_name = 'EXTRACT_M[]'.",
    "    ASSIGN: extract_m[] TO <extract>, total_m[] TO <total>,",
    "            extract_m+table_length(1) TO <ext_action>,",
    "            extract_m(x_table_length) TO <ext_wa>.                       \"#EC RC_READ",
    "    h_rc = sy-subrc.",
    "    FREE: extract_us, total_us,",
    "          extract_vs, total_vs,",
    "          extract_s, total_s,",
    "          extract_l, total_l,",
    "          extract_vl, total_vl,",
    "          extract_ul, total_ul.",
    "  ELSEIF x_table_length LE long_tab.",
    "    tot_name = 'TOTAL_L[]'. ext_name = 'EXTRACT_L[]'.",
    "    ASSIGN: extract_l[] TO <extract>, total_l[] TO <total>,",
    "            extract_l+table_length(1) TO <ext_action>,",
    "            extract_l(x_table_length) TO <ext_wa>.                        \"#EC RC_READ",
    "    h_rc = sy-subrc.",
    "    FREE: extract_us, total_us,",
    "          extract_vs, total_vs,",
    "          extract_s, total_s,",
    "          extract_m, total_m,",
    "          extract_vl, total_vl,",
    "          extract_ul, total_ul.",
    "  ELSEIF x_table_length LE very_long_tab.",
    "    tot_name = 'TOTAL_VL[]'. ext_name = 'EXTRACT_VL[]'.",
    "    ASSIGN: extract_vl[] TO <extract>, total_vl[] TO <total>,",
    "            extract_vl+table_length(1) TO <ext_action>,",
    "            extract_vl(x_table_length) TO <ext_wa>.                      \"#EC RC_READ",
    "    h_rc = sy-subrc.",
    "    FREE: extract_us, total_us,",
    "          extract_vs, total_vs,",
    "          extract_s, total_s,",
    "          extract_m, total_m,",
    "          extract_l, total_l,",
    "          extract_ul, total_ul.",
    "  ELSEIF x_table_length LE ultra_long_tab.",
    "    tot_name = 'TOTAL_UL[]'. ext_name = 'EXTRACT_UL[]'.",
    "    ASSIGN: extract_ul[] TO <extract>, total_ul[] TO <total>,",
    "            extract_ul+table_length(1) TO <ext_action>,",
    "            extract_ul(x_table_length) TO <ext_wa>.                     \"#EC RC_READ",
    "    h_rc = sy-subrc.",
    "    FREE: extract_us, total_us,",
    "          extract_vs, total_vs,",
    "          extract_s, total_s,",
    "          extract_m, total_m,",
    "          extract_l, total_l,",
    "          extract_vl, total_vl.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    msg_var = object.",
    "    PERFORM vim_bc_process_message USING 'SV' 'I' 'A' '516' msg_var",
    "                       no_msg_var no_msg_var no_msg_var tabtype.",
    "    returncode = rc_fatal. EXIT.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF h_rc NE 0.",
    "    msg_var = object.",
    "    PERFORM vim_bc_process_message USING 'SV' 'I' 'A' '149' msg_var",
    "                        no_msg_var no_msg_var no_msg_var tabtype.",
    "    returncode = rc_fatal. EXIT.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF header-bastab EQ space.                                \"view",
    "    CLEAR: tot_name, ext_name.",
    "    CONCATENATE: header-maintview tot_suffix INTO tot_name,",
    "                 header-maintview ext_suffix INTO ext_name.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "* set actopts-id (for vim_process_message)",
    "  PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                     USING 'vim_actopts-act_id'",
    "                                           'C'",
    "                                           actopts-act_id",
    "                                           h_rc.",
    "* set actopts-trsp_off (to supress transport)",
    "  PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                     USING 'vim_actopts-transp_off'",
    "                                           'C'",
    "                                           actopts-transp_off",
    "                                           h_rc.",
    "* set actopts-actlinks (to supress write of actlinks)",
    "  PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                     USING 'vim_actopts-actlinks'",
    "                                           'C'",
    "                                           actopts-actlinks",
    "                                           h_rc.",
    "* set bcset name (for vim_process_message)",
    "  READ TABLE bcset_values INDEX 1 INTO bcset_values_wa.",
    "  PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                     USING 'vim_bcset_id'",
    "                                           'C'",
    "                                           bcset_values_wa-id",
    "                                           h_rc.",
    "",
    "* get data into <TOTAL>",
    "  read_fcode = read.                                      \"SW Textimp ..",
    "  IF header-texttbexst <> space.",
    "    read_fcode = vim_read_text.",
    "  ENDIF.                                                  \".. SW Textimp",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_MAINTENANCE_LOW_LEVEL'",
    "       EXPORTING",
    "            fcode                       = read_fcode",
    "            view_action                 = 'U'",
    "            view_name                   = object",
    "       TABLES",
    "            corr_keytab                 = e071k_tab",
    "            dba_sellist                 = rangetab",
    "            dpl_sellist                 = rangetab",
    "            excl_cua_funct              = fu_to_excl",
    "            extract                     = dummy_extract",
    "            total                       = <total>",
    "            x_header                    = header",
    "            x_namtab                    = namtab",
    "       EXCEPTIONS",
    "            function_not_found          = 1",
    "*           MISSING_CORR_NUMBER         = 2",
    "            no_value_for_subset_ident   = 3",
    "*           SAVING_CORRECTION_FAILED    = 4.",
    "            error_message               = 8.",
    "  CASE sy-subrc.",
    "    WHEN 0.",
    "    WHEN 1.",
    "      msg_var = object.",
    "      PERFORM vim_bc_process_message USING 'SV' 'I' 'A' '037' msg_var",
    "                          no_msg_var no_msg_var no_msg_var tabtype.",
    "      returncode = rc_fatal. EXIT.",
    "    WHEN 3.",
    "     PERFORM vim_bc_process_message USING 'SV' 'I' 'A' '502' no_msg_var",
    "                         no_msg_var no_msg_var no_msg_var tabtype.",
    "      returncode = rc_fatal. EXIT.",
    "    WHEN 8.",
    "      PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                USING 'VIM_LAST_LOGGED_MESSAGE' 'C'",
    "                      vim_last_logged_message h_rc.",
    "      IF vim_last_logged_message-id NE sy-msgid OR",
    "         vim_last_logged_message-nbr NE sy-msgno.",
    "        PERFORM vim_bc_process_message USING sy-msgid sy-msgty sy-msgty",
    "                                          sy-msgno sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2",
    "                                          sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4 tabtype.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      returncode = rc_fatal. EXIT.",
    "  ENDCASE.",
    "",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_GET_ENTRIES_FROM_BCSET'",
    "    EXPORTING",
    "      object            = object",
    "      actopts           = actopts",
    "    IMPORTING",
    "      profile_error     = profile_error",
    "    TABLES",
    "      x_header          = header",
    "      x_namtab          = namtab",
    "      bcset_values      = bcset_values",
    "      bcset_text_values = bcset_text_values",
    "      bcset_del_records = bcset_del_records",
    "      total             = <total>",
    "      extract           = <extract>",
    "    EXCEPTIONS",
    "      internal_error    = 1",
    "      OTHERS            = 2.",
    "  IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "    PERFORM vim_bc_process_message USING 'SV' 'I' 'A' '149' no_msg_var",
    "                              no_msg_var no_msg_var no_msg_var tabtype.",
    "    returncode = rc_fatal. EXIT.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF profile_error = 2.",
    "    returncode = rc_fatal.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    IF profile_error = 1.",
    "      returncode = rc_error.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*  import data",
    "    IF header-subsetflag NE space.",
    "      PERFORM sort_tab_by_subsets TABLES namtab <extract>.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    ASSIGN: <ext_wa> TO <ext_wax> CASTING,",
    "            <ext_wax>(header-keylen) TO <ext_key>,",
    "            <ext_wax> TO <ext_wa_struc> CASTING TYPE (header-maintview).",
    "    DO.    \" for each subset.....",
    "      CLEAR entries_to_import. REFRESH entries_to_import.",
    "      REFRESH import_keytab.",
    "      fill_subset = 'X'.",
    "      LOOP AT <extract> INTO <ext_wa>.",
    "        IF header-subsetflag NE space.",
    "*        fill rangetab with subset conditions",
    "          LOOP AT namtab WHERE readonly EQ subset AND keyflag NE space.",
    "            READ TABLE rangetab WITH KEY viewfield = namtab-viewfield",
    "                                         ddic      = subset.",
    "            CHECK sy-subrc EQ 0.",
    "            sellist_ix = sy-tabix.",
    "            ASSIGN COMPONENT namtab-viewfield",
    "             OF STRUCTURE <ext_wa_struc> TO <h_1>.",
    "*            ASSIGN <ext_wa>+namtab-position(namtab-flength) TO <h_1>.",
    "            CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_CONVERSION_OUTPUT'",
    "              EXPORTING",
    "                value_intern = <h_1>",
    "                inttype      = namtab-inttype",
    "                datatype     = namtab-datatype",
    "                decimals     = namtab-decimals",
    "                convexit     = namtab-convexit",
    "                sign         = namtab-sign",
    "                outputlen    = namtab-outputlen",
    "                intlen       = namtab-flength",
    "              IMPORTING",
    "                value_extern = cur_value.",
    "            IF fill_subset = 'X'.",
    "              rangetab-value = cur_value.",
    "              CLEAR rangetab-converted.",
    "              IF cur_value = space. rangetab-initial = 'X'. ENDIF.",
